supportingInfo.valueString: 69-year-old never-smoker with stage IVB EGFR L858R-mutated adenocarcinoma of the right lower lobe (C34.31), diagnosed 2023-05. First line: osimertinib with carboplatin and pemetrexed from 2023-06, then pemetrexed maintenance. Progression on 2026-09-28 with new liver metastases (biopsy-confirmed adenocarcinoma, no small cell transformation) and rising CEA. ECOG 1. He has received both prior EGFR-directed therapy and platinum-based chemotherapy, as required by the Datroway indication for EGFR-mutated NSCLC. Requesting datopotamab deruxtecan 6 mg/kg (445 mg) IV every 3 weeks for 6 cycles, then reassessment.

resource.conclusion: Progression of disease. Right lower lobe mass enlarged to 3.4 x 2.8 cm (from nadir 2.1 x 1.7 cm). Two new hypoattenuating liver lesions in segments 6 (2.4 cm) and 7 (1.5 cm), consistent with metastases. New 1.1 cm left lower lobe nodule. Osseous metastases stable and sclerotic. No new bone lesions.

Liver segment 6 lesion, CT-guided core biopsy: metastatic adenocarcinoma, TTF-1 positive, consistent with the known lung primary. No small cell or squamous transformation identified. Tissue sent for repeat comprehensive genomic profiling.

resource.conclusion: Initial tumor genomic profiling (RLL FNA cell block, targeted NGS): EGFR exon 21 L858R detected. No ALK, ROS1, RET or NTRK fusions; no MET exon 14 skipping; KRAS and BRAF wild type. Detailed variant-level results are maintained on the genomics server, not in this report.
